about_the_game:
premium Ticket Privilege!

1.You will have access to the 'CLEAR PASS+' category in the FreeStyle Mode. This category offers the following benefits:
1-1) Early access of Premium Ticket original track [gate of elysium by kanone] (These tracks will be released for all users for free after three seasons.)
1-2) Play selected popular tracks from DLC packs (You can play tracks in the CLEAR PASS+ category regardless of whether you've purchased the DLC or not).

2. Premium Ticket user can now play any track the host selected in OPEN MATCH even if the user has not purchased the DLC. However, the user cannot select DLC track that the user has not purchased when the user is the host.

By purchasing this product, you can receive the premium product rewards for Clear Pass Season 17.

Clear Pass Season 17 runs for 90 days.

Premium rewards include new plates, comments, and DJ icons, skins, and themes.

Through this update, you can acquire new content, emoticons and combo / judgment designs.

Products are opened as CLEAR POINTs that can be obtained by playing the game and clearing songs.

(However, CP acquisition is not possible in AIR MODE.)

You can get different CPs for each mode, so try out various modes of DJMAX RESPECT V!
